title: Ventas Names Andrew L. Wattula EVP Outpatient Medical & Research
summary: Ventas, Inc. (NYSE: VTR) (“Ventas” or the “Company”) today announced that the Company has named Andrew L. Wattula Executive Vice President, Outpatient Medical Research and CEO of Lillibridge Healthcare Services, a wholly-owned property management and leasing subsidiary of Ventas, effective August 2026. He will oversee the Company’s differentiated outpatient medical and research business, which is a leading owner and manager of properties operating at the intersection of medicine, research and universities. He succeeds Peter J. Bulgarelli, who retired from Ventas in May 2026. Wattula brings deep operational, leasing and tenant engagement expertise to Ventas. Working with the Company’s in-place expert teams, Andy will focus on driving operational excellence and maximizing the performance of our portfolio. He will report to Debra A.
